tags.fixme: Is this really a separate entity from the amenity=restaurant? The amenity=cafe and amenity=bar have the same address, but only the restaurant has an FHRS record (fhrs:id=66673).
tags.name: Hazev
tags.note: In answer to the fixme question on the Hazev café and Hazev bar, I can see the justification for mapping these as distinct entities from the Hazev restaurant. They have separate entrances and are operated as separate dining areas with separate cuisines.

tags.name: The Door Hinge
tags.note: Micropub which sells real ale and real cider only, no keg beers/lagers or spirits. Has more limited opening hours than most pubs. Food limited to snacks only eg crisps.
